parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

baseURL.description: Base Zoho Sprints URL returned by the workspace lookup.

createTeamAllowed.description: Whether the authenticated user can create new teams or workspaces.

defaultPortalId.description: Default portal identifier returned by Zoho Sprints for the authenticated user.

myTeamId.description: Primary team identifier for the authenticated user.

ownerTeamIds.description: Workspace team identifiers associated with the authenticated user.

portals.description: Workspace portal summaries visible to the authenticated user.

status.description: Zoho Sprints API status string for the workspace lookup.

userDisplayName.description: Map of user identifiers to display names returned by the workspace lookup.
